name: Fuobe Frutiger aero

dataset.what: Renders Fuobe made itself (Blender, own designs).
captions: Every caption starts with "fbaero style, " and goes on in one or two long sentences (Z-Image style): who or what is in the picture, where, the light and the framing.
Describe the scene, never the look the LoRA learns (no "grainy", "film look" or the like), so the trigger carries it.
No names of people, places that identify someone, brands, camera models or photographers.

notes: fal trains on Z-Image base: whether a base-trained LoRA behaves the same on Z-Image Turbo (Soul's model) is unverified; AI-Toolkit trains on Turbo with the training adapter, so the first evaluation compares the two routes' files on Soul.
